observations.tapered_branches: The four curved trunks carry attached forks and thinner secondary branches with smooth junctions.
observations.depth_and_material: Lit curved surfaces are in front of dim recessed filaments. The hourglass housing occludes the trunks and the glass bulbs show depth.
observations.vertical_continuity: Three sampled moments in both encoded GIFs move downward. At the copy break the four matching ends preserve position, width and material.
observations.phone_legibility: At a 255 px image width, the four central trunks and their major forks stay distinct in the two panels.
observations.no_sketch_edges: The visible trunks are shaded surfaces with antialiased silhouettes and no pencil, crayon or dry-brush texture.
